## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what prevents you from doing it today?

## Proposed behavior

Show a small example of the desired command or output. For association changes, include synthetic model declarations and schema, plus the Ruby, Rails, and database adapter versions.

## Alternatives

Describe any workarounds you have tried. Remove private application details from examples.
